summary.hr: Četiri stoga slojeva: bare metal, hostirana, hipervizor u jezgri i kontejneri. Klikni sloj: koja jezgra ondje radi, što ga odvaja, što ispisuje uname -r.
summary.en: Four layer stacks: bare metal, hosted, kernel-based and containers. Click a layer: which kernel runs there, what isolates it, what uname -r prints.
